info.title: Lemma v2 API
info.description: REST surface derived from the Lemma v2 whitepaper SDK interface (§3, §4). v0.2 adds the 4 Bazaar Discovery Layer products under /v1/suites/* (see x-bazaar extension).

schema.description: Optional. When omitted or empty, the server stores the document under the registered identity-normalize schema `passthrough-v1`.

issuerId.description: Issuer identifier (DID, address, or any string). Hashed to bytes32 via keccak256 for on-chain storage.

subjectId.description: Subject/holder identifier (DID, address, or any string). Hashed to bytes32 via keccak256 for on-chain storage.

ProofRecord.description: Public proof record returned by GET /v1/proofs?docHash=. Latest proof for the given document hash.

disclosure.description: Opt-in disclosure access. Provide a ZK proof satisfying any condition attached to stored disclosures. Without this field, disclosures are never returned (privacy-by-default).

limit.description: Maximum number of results per page (1–200, default 50).

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default 0).

DataProvenance.description: Provenance on a proof-variant dataset response. contentHash is the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of `data`; a client re-hashes and compares. docHash/registeredAt/verifyUrl are optional (present once the snapshot is registered). verifyUrl resolves to GET /v1/documents/{docHash}.

contentHash.description: sha256:<hex> of the canonical JSON of data

DatasetResponse.description: A verified-provenance public dataset served under the feeds suite. data/source are byte-identical across the proof and plain variants; only provenance differs. source.attribution always present (licence requirement).

get.summary: Issuance stats for the caller's own scope
get.description: Requires an API key. The scope is resolved from the key, never from a parameter — a scope the caller could name is a scope they could snoop. `schema` narrows the result to one proof class.

get.summary: Get latest proof by document hash
get.description: Public. Returns the most recently registered proof for the given docHash.

Public. The running total of ZK proof verifications that succeeded, across every source: the public verification API and Seal sign-in (user registration and agent authentication). Verifications the relay rejected are not counted — the endpoint is unauthenticated, and a number that can be padded from outside is not one that can be published or anchored.
Public. The number of proofs issued on Lemma, across every scope. The counterpart to /v1/verification-count. Per-scope figures require an API key — see /v1/documents/stats.

post.summary: Agent Identity Issuance — issue a W3C VC v2 credential with Poseidon Merkle inclusion proof
post.description: For AI agents that need to issue verifiable identity credentials to other agents or services, this endpoint mints a W3C VC v2 credential with Poseidon Merkle inclusion proof and Groth16 zero-knowledge verification.

200.description: Credential issued, anchored, and ready for downstream verification

EXTENSION-RESPONSES.description: CDP facilitator processing status (status=accepted|processing|rejected). Returned only when settled via the CDP facilitator with discoverable: true.

schema.description: x402 challenge body. See @x402/core spec for shape.

post.summary: Inference Attestation API — Groth16 attestation that a given model produced a given output
post.description: For AI agents and companies running their own inference (Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama), this endpoint generates a Groth16 zero-knowledge attestation that proves which model produced which output, anchored on Base mainnet. Lemma never sees raw data.

200.description: Attestation generated, anchored, and ready for downstream verification

post.summary: Compliance Attestation Bundle (Basic) — BBS+ selective-disclosure proof for 2-3 standard attributes
post.description: For AI agents that need to present compliance claims (KYC status, jurisdiction, sanctions clearance) to gated endpoints without revealing underlying data, this Basic bundle returns a BBS+ selective-disclosure proof for 2-3 standard attributes per call.

200.description: Bundle generated with the requested disclosure mode

get.summary: ZK Proof Sign-in challenge — issue a single-use nonce (free, no x402)
get.description: Companion to /v1/suites/auth/proof. Returns a fresh 60-second single-use nonce that the client uses when generating the Groth16 sign-in proof. Free — payment is only required for the proof submission itself.

post.summary: ZK Proof-as-Auth (Sign-in) — verify Groth16 proof of API key possession, mint short-lived JWT
post.description: For AI agents that need to call authenticated APIs without ever holding the API key — beyond the reach of prompt injection or context leaks — this endpoint accepts a Groth16 zero-knowledge proof of API key possession and returns a short-lived JWT.

get.description: Public. Returns the latest verified snapshot of a public dataset with its provenance. Served no-cache: each read re-verifies the snapshot's proofs, advancing the public verification counter for this dataset's source. source.attribution is always present.

get.summary: Latest dataset snapshot (plain variant, no provenance)
get.description: Public control variant. Byte-identical data/source to the proof variant, with the provenance block omitted and no proof re-verification. The A/B counterpart used to isolate the effect of provenance.
